description:
Arabidopsis natural-variation GWAS from the AraGWAS Catalog (standardised GWAS of all AraPheno phenotypes on the
1001 Genomes accessions): for trait words (e.g. 'flowering time', 'seed size', 'drought'), the Arabidopsis genes with
significant SNPs (Bonferroni or permutation threshold) and their Brassica orthologues; for gene (an AGI, e.g.
AT5G10140), the phenotypes it is associated with. A GWAS SNP inside a gene is a candidate, not proof; function in the
crop is inferred by orthology: say so and give the orthology type. species: one Ensembl genome for orthologues.
name: arabidopsis_gwas
